mapper.sql: u.id AS userId, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.real_name AS realName, CASE WHEN avatar_ref.id IS NULL OR avatar_file.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar_attachment_ref_id END AS avatarAttachmentRefId, u.primary_dept_id AS primaryDeptId, d.dept_name AS primaryDeptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, u.manager_user_id AS managerUserId, m.real_name AS managerName, u.employment_status AS employmentStatus, u.status AS status, COALESCE(pref.signature, '') AS signature, COALESCE(pref.presence_status, 'ONLINE') AS presenceStatus

LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = u.primary_dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_user m ON m.id = u.manager_user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN emp_user_preference pref ON pref.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_attachment_ref avatar_ref ON avatar_ref.id = u.avatar_attachment_ref_id AND avatar_ref.owner_type = 'USER_AVATAR' AND avatar_ref.uploader_type = 'USER' AND avatar_ref.uploader_id = u.id AND avatar_ref.deleted_at IS NULL AND avatar_ref.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_file_object avatar_file ON avatar_file.id = avatar_ref.file_object_id AND avatar_file.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ct_friend f INNER JOIN org_user u ON u.id = f.friend_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.real_name ASC, u.id ASC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, friend_user_id AS friendUserId, remark, status, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM ct_friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND friend_user_id = #{friendUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM ct_friend f INNER JOIN org_user u ON u.id = f.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
WHERE f.friend_user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, u.real_name ASC, u.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ct_friend (user_id, friend_user_id, remark, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{row.userId}, #{row.friendUserId}, #{row.remark}, #{row.status}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy})
